tooltips.key: The slug Meta uses in field_data[].name. Used to match incoming leads to this question row.
tooltips.label: Human label shown in the Lead Ads form. Synced from Meta in the form's locale.
tooltips.type: Meta question type (STANDARD, CUSTOM, MULTIPLE_CHOICE, SINGLE_CHOICE, CONDITIONAL).
tooltips.options: For choice questions, the list of {key, value} options as defined in Meta. Used to resolve slugged answer values to human labels.
tooltips.contactAttribute: When set, incoming answers for this key are mapped into this Contact attribute via LeadFieldMapper. Otherwise the answer is stored only as a structured MetaLeadgenAnswer.
tooltips.isActive: Set to false automatically when the question disappears from the Meta form schema. Past Answer rows keep their reference so labels/options still render.
